_comment: BOM-specific config only. Universal conventions (refdes letter codes, power-symbol filter, missing-value sentinels) live in conventions.json so basic_checks and other modules share them. Do not duplicate them here.

property_aliases._comment: Different teams name fields differently. First match wins; lookup is case-insensitive.

_strict_mpn_categories_comment: Categories from conventions.json:refdes that MUST carry an MPN when --strict-mpn is on. Edit to suit your shop.

text_table._comment: Display widths for the printable BOM. Strings longer than max get an ellipsis. CSV/JSON exports never truncate.

csv_columns._comment: Column order and header labels for the CSV export. Keys are internal field names, values are the column headers manufacturers see.
